name: Enterprise Work Item and Iteration Binding
constraints: WM-ACT-006 owns WorkItem identity and evidence-bearing outcome.
WM-XCT-021 owns lifecycle definitions and permitted transitions; WM-ACT-003 is deferred alignment only.
Iteration commitment references WorkItems without owning their state or acceptance.
Project and programme contexts remain authoritative external masters.
Capacity, estimate, actual effort and elapsed time remain distinct facts.
Iteration is a non-normative correlated view and has no independent model identity.
holds: Iteration identifier allocation is prohibited pending independent-identity proof.
Canonical publication is held by base readiness.
